## Summary
Describe the actual implemented changes, not planned features.

## Verification
- [ ] `npm ci`
- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] Android APK built in GitHub Actions
- [ ] Windows EXE built in GitHub Actions
- [ ] Manual mobile UI checks
- [ ] Existing data migration and backups preserved

## Evidence
Link to passing CI runs and downloadable build artifacts.

## Risk and rollback
Explain schema changes, sync conflicts, and how to restore an earlier backup.

Do not merge if checks are failing or if the feature is not connected to the application.
